heavens.line: Turned his eyes up to the heavens
stanza: To help all those in need
Turned his eyes up to the heavens
Said, "The poor are yours to feed"

heavens.line: But in the space between the heavens
heavens.linePrev: Memories come rushing up to meet me now
heavens.lineNext: In the corner of some foreign field

heavens.line: Fraulein, fraulein look up toward the heavens
stanza: Fraulein, fraulein look up toward the heavens
Each night when them stars start to shine
By the same stars above you
I swear that I love you

heavens.line: And through the blood spew heavens
stanza: And through the blood spew heavens
Please let me in I have no sin—
